purpose: Reject already-consumed return-direction, return-magnitude, return-order, transaction-weight, and window variants before values and select one economically distinct price-update-continuity mechanism for the next ordered no-return audit.

closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_realized_volatility: Uses the squared magnitudes of minute returns. The selected candidate ignores every nonzero return magnitude and records only whether the close changed.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_return_variance_entropy_238m: Uses the distribution of squared return magnitudes across time. The selected candidate treats every price update identically regardless of its size or time position.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_return_sign_run_imbalance_238p: Uses the order and direction of adjacent return signs. The selected candidate discards positive versus negative direction and ignores run order.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_up_move_amount_share_238m: Allocates destination-bar amount by the sign of nonzero price moves. The selected candidate reads no amount and gives every within-half minute pair equal weight.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_amount_profile_serial_persisten: Measures persistence in the amount path without using close changes. The selected candidate measures close-update continuity without reading amount.
closest_existing_mechanisms.intraday_bar_vwap_close_pressure_240m: Measures signed close-to-same-bar-VWAP gaps using volume and amount. The selected candidate has no transaction-price reference, no activity weight, and no volume or amount field.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: zero_return_share_or_staleness
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: One minus the selected nonzero price-update share
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: This is the exact inverse direction of the selected candidate and is permanently rejected before values.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: signed_positive_or_negative_update_share
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Count only positive or only negative minute close changes
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Direction selection overlaps the terminal upside-semivariance, sign-run, and up-move-amount mechanisms and would create post-hoc direction search.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: magnitude_thresholded_update_share
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Count a price update only when its absolute return exceeds an epsilon or tick threshold
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: A threshold introduces return magnitude and a tunable cutoff; the selected mechanism is exact close equality with no tolerance.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: amount_or_volume_weighted_update_share
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Weight each price update by destination-bar amount or volume
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Weighting would reopen terminal amount-allocation and amount-volatility mechanisms.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: morning_afternoon_opening_late_or_lunch_update_share
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Compute the same update statistic on a selected subwindow, include 09:30, or include the lunch boundary
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Window selection is formula search; 09:30 has known placeholder ambiguity and the lunch boundary is not a one-minute price-update interval.

rejected_before_value_observation.name: longest_unchanged_run_or_update_run
rejected_before_value_observation.proposed_formula: Use the maximum duration of a flat or updating close sequence
rejected_before_value_observation.reason: Run-length selection changes the mechanism into an order statistic and overlaps the consumed sign-run family.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_price_update_share_238m
selected_candidate.formula: Count(close_hj != close_h,j-1 for h in {morning, afternoon}, j=2..120) / 238
selected_candidate.bar_grid: Use the 120 closes at 09:31-11:30 and the 120 closes at 13:01-15:00. Form 119 adjacent pairs inside each half, exclude standalone 09:30 and the 11:30-to-13:01 lunch boundary.
selected_candidate.equality_rule: Use exact equality of the normalized source close values after finite-positive validation. No epsilon, tick threshold, rounding, or tolerance is allowed.
selected_candidate.mechanism: Price-update continuity measures how often the close incorporates a new transaction price from one minute to the next rather than remaining stale.
selected_candidate.hypothesis: A high close-known value indicates continuous price discovery and lower price staleness, which may improve the persistence and executability of cross-sectional information from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.economic_distinction: The candidate is invariant to the size and sign of every nonzero return and to any common positive price rescaling. It uses no amount, volume, source open/high/low, transaction VWAP, daily price, or forward return. Permuting nonzero return magnitudes without changing which pairs are zero leaves it unchanged.
